scenarios.description: Off-topic, nonsense and rule-breaking input each get a clear can't-help reply, and no errand is started.
scenarios.expected: every reply says it can't help with that and what it can do; no tool is called and no errand exists

scenarios.description: The scripted user's Approve click reaches the app API's approve endpoint, which is a stub until ticket 05.
scenarios.expected: the Approve click reaches POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/approve with the card's fingerprint and gets 501 not_implemented; a click without a fingerprint gets 400

attempts.actual: 2 turns; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (8 providers); approve prp_ticket02_stub → 501 not_implemented

scenarios.description: A model that loops forever stops at the tool-call cap, and the person sees the budget-exhausted message.
scenarios.expected: exactly 3 tool calls run, the next is refused; outcome budget_exhausted (tool_calls); the reply is the outcome's message

attempts.actual: 3 tool calls; reply: I stopped working on this because it reached the most action

scenarios.description: A model that loops forever stops at the model-turn cap, and the person sees the budget-exhausted message.
scenarios.expected: the run stops after 4 model calls and 3 tool calls; outcome budget_exhausted (model_turns); the reply is the outcome's message

attempts.actual: 3 tool calls; reply: I stopped working on this because it reached the most steps

scenarios.description: A tool throws something unknown: the run ends failed with a message, the errand fails, and nothing else runs.
scenarios.expected: search_providers throws; the run ends failed (tool_error) with the outcome's message as the reply; the errand goes gathering → failed; no tool runs after the error

attempts.actual: update_errand completed, search_providers failed; reply: Something went wrong on my side, so I stopped here without t

scenarios.description: A slow tool stops the run within its wall-clock deadline, and the person sees the budget-exhausted message.
scenarios.expected: the slow search is cut off at the 1500 ms deadline; the run ends budget_exhausted (wall_clock) within 4000 ms; the reply is the outcome's message

attempts.actual: search_providers failed; reply: I stopped working on this because it reached the time one re

scenarios.description: Changing the date after seeing options changes only the date; service, area and budget stay.
scenarios.expected: after the date change the errand holds Saturday, and service, area and budget are unchanged; the errand went back to gathering and on to choosing, all traced

attempts.actual: 2 turns; update_errand(plumber, Koramangala) → updated; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (8 providers); update_errand() → updated; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (8 providers)

scenarios.description: A fully specified request is searched in the same turn, with no clarifying question.
scenarios.expected: one turn: the errand is complete with no question, search_providers runs in that turn with nothing asked before it, and the errand ends choosing

attempts.actual: 1 turn; update_errand(plumber, Koramangala) → updated; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (8 providers)

scenarios.description: A request missing only the area gets exactly one question, about the area, then a search once it is answered.
scenarios.expected: turn 1: the errand misses only the area, the reply asks exactly one question (about the area) with area quick replies, no search; after the answer the errand is choosing with the area filled; every transition is in the trace

attempts.actual: 2 turns; update_errand(plumber) → updated; update_errand(Koramangala) → updated; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (8 providers)

scenarios.description: With a budget and mornings only, every provider and option shown is within budget and inside the window, tagged.
scenarios.expected: 2–3 options tagged best match, cheapest and earliest; every provider and option shown costs at most ₹800 (by the world's price) and every slot shown is a morning this week; the over-budget ones are counted as left out

attempts.actual: 1 turn; update_errand(plumber, Koramangala) → updated; search_providers(plumber, Koramangala) → found (3 providers)

scenarios.description: A plain errand searches the right service and area and returns the world's providers.
scenarios.expected: search_providers runs once for plumber in Koramangala; 3 to 8 providers, each matching the world's price and rating
